key_sre_lessons_learned: Never use '..Default::default()' struct update syntax in production structs in syspilot-core or syspilot-tray; cargo-mutants generates 'delete field <f> from struct' mutants which are equivalent when field values equal Default.
verify-rust.sh supports per-crate mutation testing (--mutants crates/syspilot-core/... or crates/syspilot-tray/... or crates/syspilot-gui/...) and git diff mutation testing (--mutants-diff -q).
